context: Migrated from a flat scenario file. Tests: Shared Template Refactor for a Multi-Service Pipeline.

checklist.name: extends or YAML anchors used
checklist.description: The YAML uses `extends:` referencing a hidden job template (dot-prefixed) OR YAML anchors (`&`/`<<: *`) to share common configuration

checklist.name: No duplicate before_script
checklist.description: The common setup command (npm ci or equivalent) appears in ONE place (template/anchor/default), NOT repeated in each service job

checklist.name: Image declared once
checklist.description: The Node image is declared in ONE location (default block, shared template, or anchor), not duplicated across every job

checklist.name: Cache configured
checklist.description: A `cache:` block is present, configured for node_modules or equivalent dependency directory

checklist.name: Cache key uses CI variable
checklist.description: The cache `key:` references a GitLab CI predefined variable (e.g. $CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG) rather than a static string

checklist.name: needs for per-service DAG
checklist.description: Each service's test job uses `needs:` to reference only its own service's build job

checklist.name: Image pinned
checklist.description: The shared image tag does NOT use `:latest`

checklist.name: No only/except
checklist.description: The YAML does NOT use `only:` or `except:`
